title: Huawei Found Guilty of Stealing Secrets
summary:
A jury in a court in Brooklyn has found the big Chinese technology company Huawei guilty of a crime. The company was found guilty of planning to steal trade secrets and of bank fraud.

The jury found Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts. One of the counts was breaking US sanctions, which are rules that stop a country or company from trading with others. But the jury did not find Huawei guilty of racketeering. That charge would have meant the jury thought Huawei acted like a criminal gang.

The lawyers for the US government said Huawei lied, cheated and stole to get ahead of other companies. They said Huawei spent 20 years doing whatever it took to grow, including lying to banks about its business in Iran and taking technology secrets from other companies.

Huawei's lawyers said the company grew because of its own new ideas, not because of crime. The company said being cleared of the racketeering charge shows those claims had no facts behind them.
why_it_matters: It shows that even the biggest companies must follow the law, and that courts decide what is fair.
